The next morning, Eve walked into the memorial service for Erin Albright. Shauna Hunnicut was seated in the front row, surrounded by friends and family. She spotted Lopez and Barney, both of whom looked somber but also seemed to be trying to blend into the background.

As the service progressed, Eve listened attentively to the eulogies and speeches. She took note of the emotions expressed by the speakers, particularly the pain and sadness. She also observed the reactions of the attendees, looking for any signs of unease or discomfort.

After the service, Eve approached Shauna and offered her condolences. "Shauna, I'm so sorry for your loss," she said, placing a hand on Shauna's shoulder. "Erin was a wonderful person, and I know she'll be deeply missed."

Shauna looked up at Eve, her eyes red-rimmed from crying. "Thank you, Lieutenant. It's been a tough day." Eve nodded sympathetically. "I can only imagine. Can I ask you something?"

"Of course," Shauna replied, wiping away a tear.

"Do you remember if Erin mentioned anyone she might have trusted with the surprise?" Eve asked, trying to keep her tone neutral.

Shauna thought for a moment before responding. "No, I don't think so. Erin was always secretive about her plans, but I didn't think it was unusual. She loved surprises."

Eve nodded, making a mental note to follow up on this lead. She thanked Shauna and turned to leave, but not before catching a glimpse of Lopez and Barney lingering at the back of the crowd.

As she walked out of the memorial service, Eve couldn't shake the feeling that she was missing something. She had a nagging sense that there was more to Erin's murder than met the eye, and she was determined to uncover the truth.

Mira's voice was calm and professional. "Hey, Eve. I've been going over the case files, and I think I might have found something interesting."

Eve's interest piqued, she leaned forward in her chair. "What is it, Mira?"

Mira paused, choosing her words carefully. "I think Erin's murder might have been a crime of passion, but not just any crime of passion. I think it was a crime of revenge."

Eve's eyes widened as she processed Mira's words. "Revenge? What do you mean?"

Eve's mind was racing as she considered Mira's words. She had a feeling that Mira was onto something, and she was determined to uncover the truth.

Through it all, Eve remained focused on finding justice for Erin Albright and her loved ones. She was determined to uncover the truth, no matter what it took.

In the end, Eve's perseverance paid off. She uncovered the identity of the killer and brought them to justice.
